## Publication Information

**Date:** 1873-1874

**Imprint:** London: Mozley

**Notes:** This originally appeared in the <i>Monthly Paper of Sunday Teaching</i>.  It was a translation of François Samuel Louis Gaussen, <i>Daniel le prophète, exposé dans une suite de leçons</i> 2 vols (Paris: Librairie protestante 1848-1850).
